purpose: Synthetic design cases for scope-aware research-state routing. They contain no real task content, hidden labels, real memory records, credentials, user data or measured outcomes.

fixtures.scenario: Two tasks share prominent words but have disjoint source-family lineage, incompatible goals and no verified reusable mechanism. The router assigns them to one cluster based on lexical similarity.
An agent copies a finding from cluster A into cluster B without a transfer receipt, source evidence identity or target-scope check.
A finding scored under evaluator epoch E1 is surfaced as current evidence under E2 without bridge/revalidation or a scope-validity check.
The router sees a future task ID or hidden family label that reveals which cluster contains the answer or relevant payoff.
A method relies on an API/tool action unavailable in the destination task, but the router recommends direct reuse without an adapter or capability check.
Unrelated task families are merged into one global cluster; retrieval exposes conflicting, irrelevant or capability-incompatible experience and increases downstream error or cost.
Every task instance receives a new cluster despite sharing an adjudicated family and reusable mechanism; the system loses validated transfer and incurs duplicate storage/index/retrieval cost.
Two sibling scopes contain incompatible but individually valid findings. The router collapses them into one global fact or discards one without recording scope, time and provenance.
The router uses private task rewards, final correctness labels or future measured outcomes to choose the cluster during evaluation.
A proposed cross-family sharing decision has no source-family lineage, no evidence anchor and no independent mechanism-transfer receipt, yet it is accepted as a positive transfer.
Two tasks belong to the same adjudicated family, use compatible action/tool contracts and share a current verified mechanism. The router selects the existing family cluster and records the route.
fixtures.note: Synthetic positive control; eligibility still depends on the real evidence and independent scope manifest.

fixtures.scenario: An adjacent family may reuse one mechanism after a separately verified transfer probe establishes its applicability. The transfer receipt binds source and destination scope, mechanism and evidence.
fixtures.note: Synthetic positive control; no automatic generalization from lexical or task similarity.

fixtures.scenario: A task arrives after its dependency/evaluator context changed. The router returns the relevant record only with its historical as-of state and requires revalidation before current use.
fixtures.note: Correct handling of stale evidence preserves history without granting current authority.

fixtures.scenario: Two scopes contain incompatible findings. Both are retained with provenance and scope; the router declines to merge them and exposes the conflict only to an authorized query.
fixtures.note: Preserving a scoped contradiction is preferable to manufacturing consensus.

fixtures.scenario: The task description is insufficient to distinguish two plausible task families and available scope descriptors do not resolve the ambiguity.
fixtures.note: Abstention is the correct result when scope is not identifiable.

fixtures.scenario: A potentially useful cross-family mechanism is reported, but its source artifact, evaluator epoch or transfer evidence is missing.
fixtures.note: Do not share state until provenance and applicability can be checked.

scoring_policy.hard_gate_rule: Every negative fixture has a hard gate. Any real router that admits the prohibited route fails the relevant integrity criterion regardless of task score.
scoring_policy.positive_control_rule: Positive fixture descriptions test whether valid, scoped reuse and evidence-bearing transfer are possible; they are not proof of real-world transfer.
scoring_policy.abstention_rule: Unidentified scope or insufficient provenance must remain unresolved; forced routing is a failure.
scoring_policy.denominator_rule: All route attempts, rejected routes, abstentions and costs remain in the denominator. Do not report only successful reuse.
scoring_policy.replication_unit: Complete stateful task rollout / stream. Task instances within one evolving cluster state are dependent observations.
scoring_policy.authority_boundary: Fixture pack and its validator do not authenticate real source-family labels, scope evidence, independent custodians or memory stores.
